name: adv_variant_selects_eqpct
source:
// model$ picks the VARIANT body: eqpct must use Cveff = Cv*R^(u-1), so the
// local Cveff exists and the fixed/linear laws must NOT be emitted.
COMPONENT FluidBoundary(out)
  PARAM P, h, mdot
  out.P    = P
  out.h    = h
  out.mdot = mdot
END
FluidBoundary SRC(f1, P = 500000, h = 196595, mdot = 2.0)
Valve         VA(f1, f2, Cv = 0.01, rho = 980, u = 0.5, R = 50, model$ = eqpct)
Sink          SK(f2)
dp    = f1.P - f2.P
cveff = VA.Cveff
m     = f2.mdot
